Abood Bin Hussain, Adilabad Dist. vs The Dist.Collector,
Adilabad Dist., ... on 10 September, 2024
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C.V.Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.10620 of 2013
Order:

entities.text:
Abood Bin Hussain, Adilabad Dist. vs The Dist.Collector,
Adilabad Dist
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This Writ Petition is filed seeking the following relief:
"....to issue a Writ, Order or Direction more particularly a Writ of Mandamus declaring the action of the respondents in not initiating the land acquisition proceedings under the provisions of Land Acquisition Act and not paying the compensation amount to the petitioner for the acquisition of the land to an extent of Acs.17-12 gts in Sy.No.10 (Old Sy.No.5) situated at Sakera Village, Utnoor Mandal,
Adilabad District for the purpose of construction of Sakera Project even though the petitioner has submitted number of representations to the respondents as illegal,
arbitrary, abuse of process of law and violation of principles of natural justice and contrary to the provisions of the land acquisition act and consequently direct the respondents to pay the compensation to the petitioner by initiating the land acquisition proceedings in the interest of justice...."

2. Considered the submissions of the learned counsel for the respective parties and perused the record.
3.

The petitioner claims to be the owner and possessor of lands admeasuring Acs.20-00 guntas in Sy.No.10 (Old Sy.No.5) situated at Sakera Village, Utnoor Mandal, Adilabad District and his name is mutated in all the revenue records.

The case of the petitioner is that in the year 1992, the respondents have acquired an extent of Acs.2-28 guntas in Sy.No.10 of his land for the purpose of Sakera Project and paid compensation to the said acquired lands.

It is the further case of the petitioner that CVBR,J wp_10620_2013 without initiating proceedings under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short 'the Act') the respondents have acquired remaining lands of Acs.17-12 guntas in Sy.No.10 in the second phase for the purpose of Sakera Project and therefore, he submitted a representation, dated 26.07.2010 before respondent No.2 requesting to provide certain information with regard to acquisition of lands to extent of Acs.20-00 guntas in Sy.No.10, but respondent No.2 failed to consider the said representation and failed to pay the compensation to an extent of Acs.20-00 guntas.
4.

A counter affidavit has been filed by respondent No.4 stating that an extent of Acs.2-25 guntas in Sy.No.10 (Old Sy.No.5) situated at Sakera Village, Utnoor Mandal, Adilabad District, has been acquired by the respondents for formation of Sakera Project and accordingly, compensation was paid to the petitioner, along with the enhanced decretal amount.

It is further stated that the respondents have not acquired the remaining land to an extent of Acs.17-12 guntas in Sy.No.10 as Abood Bin Hussain, Adilabad Dist. vs The Dist.Collector, Adilabad Dist., ... on 10 September, 2024

1 claimed by the petitioner, and therefore, compensation to the entire extent of land in Sy.No.10 cannot be paid, as the remaining land to an extent of Acs.17-12 guntas in Sy.No.10, is in possession of the petitioner only.
CVBR,J wp_10620_2013 5.

In view of the above submissions, this Court deems it appropriate to dispose of the Writ Petition directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioner for the remaining extent of Acs.17-12 guntas in Sy.No.10 and if the lands of the petitioner is required for the purpose of Sakera Project, the respondents are directed to follow the procedure laid down under law.
6. With the above observations, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Writ Petition shall stand closed.

JUSTICE C.V.BHASKAR REDDY Date: 10.09.2024 sus Abood Bin Hussain, Adilabad Dist. vs The Dist.Collector, Adilabad Dist., ... on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58073384/
